subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Keystone Housing licence renewal overdue - service suspension 06/11
summary: Email claiming to be from Keystone Software says the Keystone Housing licence is overdue and will be suspended unless a renewal invoice is paid via a link.

messages.body:
Dear Customer,

Our records show that the annual licence for **Keystone Housing** (Account SVH-0047) expired on 31/10/2026 and the renewal invoice remains unpaid.

To avoid suspension of your housing management system on **Friday 06/11/2026**, please review and settle the renewal invoice using our secure licensing portal:

https://keystone-software-licensing.com/renew?acc=SVH-0047

You will need to sign in with your Microsoft 365 credentials to verify you are an authorised contact.

Failure to act will result in loss of access to tenancy, rent and repairs data for all users.

Kind regards,

Licensing Team
Keystone Software Ltd

triage.action: Do not click the link or sign in. Report with the Outlook 'Report phishing' button, forward as an attachment to IT (Craig Whitmore) and delete. IT to check whether anyone else received it or entered credentials.
triage.notes: Lookalike domain (keystone-software-licensing.com - genuine Keystone Software emails come from keystonesoftware.co.uk). The Keystone contract runs to 31 March 2027 and is managed by IT, so a licence 'expiring 31/10' is false. Urgency, threat of suspension and a request for M365 credentials are classic phishing signs. Wrong mailbox for genuine supplier mail anyway.

subject: my mum - Flat 13 Bearsted Court - worried
summary: Daughter of an 87-year-old SilverLiving resident living alone at Bearsted Court says her mother has not answered the phone since Sunday and a neighbour says the curtains have been closed for two days.

messages.body:
Hello

I'm sorry to email this address but I couldn't get through on the phone after 5pm.

My mum is Gemma Jackson, Flat 13 Bearsted Court. She's 87 and lives on her own. I ring her every evening and she hasn't picked up since Sunday. I live in Inverness so I can't just pop round. Her neighbour Pat texted me today to say mum's curtains have been shut since Monday and she didn't come down for the coffee morning.

She does have one of your pull cords but I don't think she wears the pendant.

Can someone please knock on her door? I'm really worried.

Karen (her daughter)
07700 900815

triage.action: Phone the SilverLiving Coordinator (Margaret Ogunleye) or the Careline/out-of-hours team now for an immediate welfare check at Flat 13 Bearsted Court. If there is no answer, use the master key procedure and call 999 / the police for a welfare check. Call Karen back on 07700 900815 once the check is done and log it on Keystone.
triage.notes: Received at 19:06 on 4 Nov, after the mailbox was last checked - so it sat overnight. Classic buried emergency: polite, apologetic tone. Gemma Jackson (87) lives alone and is not flagged as vulnerable in Keystone, so a vulnerability-flag rule would miss it. Do not wait for the daily welfare call round.

subject: Complaint CMP-24201 - final warning
summary: Kings Hill Quarter resident with an open stage 2 complaint says nobody has called her back and she will go to the Housing Ombudsman and her MP this week.

messages.body:
To whoever reads this inbox

My complaint is CMP-24201. I asked for it to go to stage 2 on the 25th October because NOBODY RETURNS MY CALLS which was the whole point of the complaint in the first place. Since then I have had one automated email. Nothing else.

I have five people in this house and I am sick of being ignored. If I dont hear from a manager by Friday I am going to the Housing Ombudsman and I've already drafted an email to my MP.

Rosie Allen
54 Kings Hill Quarter

triage.action: Add to the existing stage 2 complaint CMP-24201 (handler Owen Fletcher, stage 2 response due 1 December 2026). Owen or a manager to phone Rosie by Friday 6 November, agree a contact plan, and confirm in writing her right to go to the Housing Ombudsman. Do not open a new complaint.
triage.notes: Not a new complaint - it is a further contact on CMP-24201, which is open at stage 2. Under the Complaint Handling Code residents can go to the Ombudsman at any time; the reply should say so, not try to discourage it.

subject: Member enquiry - Mrs Khan, 9 Brenchley Gardens (damp)
summary: Borough councillor asks for an update on mould at 9 Brenchley Gardens on behalf of resident Sara Khan, who says she reported it weeks ago and nobody has been.

messages.body:
Good morning,

I have been contacted by my constituent Mrs Sara Khan of 9 Brenchley Gardens about black mould in her back bedroom and bathroom. She says she mentioned it when she did your satisfaction survey and was told someone would be in touch, but she has heard nothing.

Mrs Khan is 68 and tells me her chest has been bad this autumn.

Could you let me know when an inspection will take place and what you are doing more generally at Brenchley Gardens? This is the fourth damp case on the estate I've raised this year.

Kind regards

Cllr Pauline Marsh
Shepway South ward

triage.action: Log as a member enquiry and acknowledge Cllr Marsh within 1 working day. Ask the Damp & Mould Surveyor (Ellie Novak, case DM1120) to confirm the inspection date - the Awaab's Law investigation is due by 11 November 2026 - and consider whether the resident's chest problems make it more urgent. Full reply within 10 working days, signed off by the Director of Customer Experience.
triage.sla: Acknowledge 1 working day; respond 10 working days
triage.notes: DM1120 exists (raised from the TSM survey on 28 Oct, Significant, awaiting investigation). The councillor's claim that 'nobody has been' is true but the case is still within its 10-working-day window. The health information may justify bringing the visit forward.

subject: FW: Constituent case - Mr F Smith, Flat 63 Lenham Meadows
summary: MP's caseworker forwards a constituent's complaint that he was told his mould was condensation and to open windows, with no inspection.

from.name: Joel Harker (Office of Helen Bryant MP)

messages.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please see below from our constituent Mr Frank Smith. We would be grateful for a response we can share with him.

Many thanks

Joel Harker
Senior Caseworker, Office of Helen Bryant MP

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Frank Smith
Sent: 03 November 2026 20:14

Dear Ms Bryant

I rent from Silvering Homes at Flat 63 Lenham Meadows. We have mould on the bedroom walls and the window frames. When I reported it through the app I was told it was condensation and to open the windows and wipe it down. No-one has come out to look at it. I have made a complaint but I don't feel I'm getting anywhere. We have four people in the flat. Can you help?

Frank Smith

triage.action: Log as an MP enquiry and link it to open complaint CMP-24176 (handler Mark Pennington). Raise a damp and mould case today so the Damp & Mould Surveyor can carry out an Awaab's Law investigation within 10 working days. Acknowledge the MP's office within 1 working day; full response within 10 working days, signed off by a director.
triage.sla: Acknowledge 1 working day; respond 10 working days
triage.notes: Planted gap: CMP-24176 (received 29 Oct via MySilvering, 'told it was condensation') is open but there is NO record in damp_mould_cases for Frank Smith. Advice to 'open the windows' without an inspection is exactly what the damp and mould policy forbids.

subject: Thank you to Lee
summary: Rosemount Tower resident thanks plumber Lee Barton for fixing a leak quickly and tidying up.

messages.body:
Hello

I just wanted to say thank you to the young man Lee who came on Tuesday about my leaking pipe under the sink. He was polite, explained everything and even put a towel down. He was finished in half an hour. Please tell his boss.

Anna Williams
Flat 78 Rosemount Tower

triage.action: Log the compliment (Resident Involvement & Insight) and forward to Lee Barton and the Head of Repairs. Short thank-you reply to Mrs Williams.
triage.notes: Compliments count towards resident feedback reporting; send a thank-you within 5 working days.

subject: Automatic reply: Joint visit request - Flat 11 Bearsted Court
summary: Out-of-office auto-reply from a community mental health practitioner, giving an alternative contact.

messages.body:
Thank you for your email. I am on annual leave until Monday 9th November with no access to email.

For urgent matters please contact the duty team on 01622 900 310 or dutyteam@westkentwellbeing.example.org.

triage.action: No reply needed. If the joint visit for Flat 11 Bearsted Court cannot wait until 9 November, the SilverLiving Coordinator should contact the duty team instead.

subject: swap my flat
summary: Starter tenant at Hop Pocket Way asks how to do a mutual exchange to be nearer her mum in Tonbridge.

messages.body:
hi

I want to swap my flat for something in Tonbridge so im closer to my mum who is poorly. I've found someone on SwapNest who wants to come to maidstone. what do I do next? do I need a form

thanks
Jasmine (flat 43 hop pocket way)

triage.action: Lettings Officer (Chloe Benson) to reply explaining mutual exchange and that a starter (introductory) tenancy normally has to become assured before an exchange can be approved; check her tenancy start date and offer to discuss options, including a management transfer if her mum's health is a factor.
triage.notes: Jasmine is on a Starter (12 months) tenancy, so she may not be eligible yet - the reply should explain why rather than just say no.

subject: Subject access request
summary: Former tenant asks for copies of all personal data Silvering holds about her, including repair records and notes from phone calls.

messages.body:
Dear Silvering Homes

Under the UK GDPR I am requesting a copy of all the personal data you hold about me. This includes my tenancy file, rent account, repair records, any notes made about me during phone calls or visits, emails, and any recordings.

I was a tenant at 22 Ringlestone Crescent until March 2025. My date of birth is 14/06/1977.

Please send the information to this email address.

Yours faithfully

Deborah Lane

triage.action: Forward the same day to Information Governance (dpo@silvering-homes.org.uk, People, IT & Data) to log as a subject access request; ID check as per the procedure. The statutory deadline is one calendar month from receipt: 28 November 2026. The contact centre must not send any data itself.
triage.sla: Forward same day; respond by 28 November 2026
triage.notes: Received 28 Oct 2026 and still in the mailbox on 5 Nov - already 8 days of the month used. Former tenant, so she won't appear in the current tenancies table.

subject: Noise from upstairs every night
summary: Shepway Green resident reports loud music and banging from the flat above most nights after midnight.

messages.body:
Hi,

The people in the flat above me (I'm in flat 37 Shepway Green) have music on and are banging and shouting most nights from about midnight till 3. It's been going on for about 3 weeks. I start work at 6. I've knocked once and they just laughed.

What can you do?

Ron Myers

triage.action: Log an ASB case (noise) and pass to the patch Housing Officer (Amira Haddad) to contact Ron within 3 working days, complete the risk assessment, send diary sheets and offer the noise app. Escalate to the ASB & Tenancy Enforcement Officer (Gary Doyle) if threats or harassment emerge.
triage.sla: 3 working days (risk assessment within 1 working day of contact)
triage.notes: Routine noise report - no threats or vulnerability mentioned. ASB risk assessments are a known gap (asb_no_risk_assessment fact), so the action should make sure one is done.

subject: Media enquiry - Brenchley Gardens mould - deadline 3pm today
summary: Local newspaper reporter asks for a statement on mould at Brenchley Gardens and the number of open damp cases, with a 3pm deadline on Thursday 5 November.

messages.body:
Hi there,

I'm a reporter at the Maidstone & Medway Gazette. We're running a story tomorrow about residents at Brenchley Gardens who say their homes have black mould and repairs are taking months.

Could Silvering Homes give us a statement, and tell us:

1. How many open damp and mould cases you have at Brenchley Gardens
2. Whether you are meeting the Awaab's Law timescales
3. What you are doing to fix the estate

My deadline is **3pm today (Thursday)**.

Thanks

Tom Fairweather
Maidstone & Medway Gazette
07700 900 552

triage.action: Forward immediately to the Communications Manager (Lucy Carver), who will agree a statement with the Director of Property and the Chief Executive. The contact centre must not reply, confirm any figures or comment.
triage.notes: Arrived at 08:34 on the day of the deadline. Only Communications speaks to the press.

subject: Staircasing - Flat 3 Orchard Fields
summary: New shared owner at Orchard Fields asks how soon he can buy a bigger share and whether he needs a new valuation.

messages.body:
Hello,

We moved into Flat 3 Orchard Fields last month on a 40% share. My parents have offered to help us buy more. How soon can we staircase, is there a minimum % and do we need a RICS valuation even though the flat is brand new?

Also still waiting on the snagging for the bathroom extractor - is that you or Castlemere?

Thanks,
Ray Davis

triage.action: Sales & Shared Ownership Officer (Kirsty Lambert) to reply with the staircasing process, minimum tranche and valuation rules from the lease. Pass the extractor fan snag to the Development Manager (Paul Whitaker) as a new-build defect for Castlemere.
triage.notes: Two issues in one email - the defect at the end is easy to miss. Shared owners are the least satisfied group (LCHO TSM).

subject: Formal complaint - grass not cut and bins
summary: Heron Way resident makes a formal complaint about missed grass cuts over the summer and overflowing communal bins.

messages.body:
I wish to make a formal complaint.

The grass at the back of the Heron Way flats was cut twice between June and September. We pay a service charge for grounds maintenance. The communal bin store also overflows every week and there are now rats. I have phoned three times.

I would like a refund of the grounds part of my service charge.

J. Donnelly
Flat 30 Heron Way

triage.action: Log a stage 1 complaint (estate services & cleaning) in Keystone and acknowledge within 5 working days - by 3 November 2026. Complaints Officer (Mark Pennington) to investigate with the grounds contract manager (Greenway Grounds, managed by the Head of Neighbourhoods) and respond within 10 working days of acknowledgement. Report the rats to Repairs as a pest control job.
triage.sla: Acknowledge 5 working days; respond 10 working days
triage.notes: Received 27 Oct, so the 5-working-day acknowledgement deadline (3 Nov) has already passed by 5 Nov. Ties in with Greenway Grounds' Amber rating and summer 2026 missed grass cuts.

subject: Lift broken AGAIN Parkwood Court
summary: Parkwood Court resident with a toddler reports the lift has been out for four days and asks when the inspection will be done.

messages.body:
Lift at Parkwood Court has been broken since Saturday. Again. I'm on the 4th floor with a toddler and a buggy and the man in flat 39 can't get out at all he's in a wheelchair. There was a notice in September saying the lift inspection was due and nobody ever came. Is it even safe?

Bethany
Flat 42

triage.action: Wrong mailbox for a repair but treat as urgent: pass to the Building Safety Manager (Fatima Begum) today to chase Liftwise Engineering, confirm the overdue LOLER thorough examination, and arrange welfare checks for residents who cannot use the stairs (Flat 39). Reply to Bethany with an update.
triage.notes: Parkwood Court's LOLER thorough examination was due 28 Sep 2026 and is Overdue in building_safety; Liftwise is rated Red. The wheelchair user is a second, buried vulnerability.

subject: Housing Ombudsman - request for information - CMP-24019 (Ms D Collins)
summary: Housing Ombudsman caseworker requests the full complaint file and repairs history for Dawn Collins' damp complaint within 15 working days.

messages.body:
Dear Silvering Homes

We are now investigating this complaint. Please provide the following within **15 working days** of the date of this email:

triage.action: Customer Resolutions Manager (Owen Fletcher) to log the request on CMP-24019 and coordinate the evidence pack with Repairs and Damp & Mould. Deadline 15 working days from 2 November: 23 November 2026.
triage.notes: Genuine Ombudsman request (not phishing - no links or credential requests). CMP-24019 is 'With Housing Ombudsman - referred, awaiting determination'.

subject: Re: Your call today
summary: One-line reply from a resident confirming a callback time, with no context.

messages.body:
yes after 2 is fine thanks

Sent from my iPhone

triage.action: Search Keystone contact notes for a call with Toby Rogers (124 Shepway Green) on 4 November and add the callback preference to that task. No reply needed.
triage.notes: Realistic orphan reply - the adviser who made the call didn't log it. Customer Service Team Leader to find who owns the callback.

subject: Careline charge on my rent statement
summary: Willow House SilverLiving resident queries a Careline charge on her statement and says she doesn't use the alarm.

messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

I have had my statement and there is a charge for Careline. I have never pressed the button and my son says I shouldn't have to pay for something I don't use. Can it be taken off please?

Yours sincerely

Mrs M Ward
Flat 9 Willow House

triage.action: Wrong mailbox (rent/service charge) but a SilverLiving matter: SilverLiving Coordinator (Margaret Ogunleye) to call Mrs Ward to explain that Careline is part of the scheme's support charge and check the alarm is working; copy the Rents team. Do not remove the charge without the Income Manager's agreement.
triage.notes: Her rent account is actually in credit, so there is no arrears risk. A phone call is better than an email for an 80-year-old resident.

subject: mould in babys room again
summary: Brenchley Gardens tenant reports black mould back in her 7-month-old baby's bedroom, on the ceiling and the cot side; the baby is wheezing and on an inhaler.

messages.body:
Hi

The black mould has come back in the baby's room. You came last year and sprayed it and put a fan in but its back worse than before, its on the ceiling above the cot and down the wall and theres black spots on the cot side now. My son is 7 months old and the GP has given him an inhaler for his chest and said the mould isn't helping. Hes been wheezing at night.

I've moved the cot into my room for now but theres no space really. Please can someone come this week

Joanne Blake
17 Brenchley Gardens
07700 900478

triage.action: Treat as an Awaab's Law emergency hazard: phone Joanne first thing, and arrange for the home to be made safe (mould treatment, ventilation, temporary room or decant if needed) within 24 hours of receipt - by 22:41 on 5 November 2026. Damp & Mould Surveyor (Ellie Novak) to open a new case linked to DM1022, investigate, and send the written summary within 3 working days of investigation. Inform the Head of Repairs.
triage.sla: Make safe within 24 hours of receipt
triage.notes: Recurrence of DM1022 (Nov 2025, condensation, treated and closed). Infant with a respiratory condition = significant risk of harm, so the emergency timescale applies, not the 10-working-day one. Arrived late evening and could easily be read as routine. The tenancy record shows children but no vulnerability flag - update it.

subject: gas smell
summary: Heron Way tenant says she can smell gas in her kitchen since getting up and asks whether she can wait for her support worker at 10am.

messages.body:
hi I can smell gas in my kichen since I got up its quite strong near the boiler cupbord. my support worker isnt coming till 10. is it ok to wait for her

Francesca
5 heron way

triage.action: Phone Francesca immediately (07700 900964): tell her not to use switches or flames, open windows, turn off the gas at the meter if she can, leave the house and call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999. Raise an emergency gas job in FieldLoop (attend within 4 hours / make safe within 24) and tell the Compliance Officer (Gas & Electrical). Contact her support worker.
triage.notes: Gas leaks should never be reported by email - the triage key wants a phone call straight away, not a reply. Francesca has a learning disability flag in Keystone; she is asking permission to wait, so a written reply could be misunderstood. There is an unrelated Weald Roofing job open at the same address (RJ405990).

subject: STILL NO HEATING - complaint CMP-24162 - 3rd email
summary: Brenchley Gardens tenant with a mobility condition and children says the heating is still not fixed after parts were 'ordered', quoting his open complaint.

messages.body:
This is my 3rd email. Complaint number CMP-24162.

The heating at flat 120 still doesn't work. Your man came and said parts were ordered and someone would ring. Nobody has. It was 2 degrees last night. I have two kids and I can't get to the shops easily with my legs to buy heaters.

When is someone coming?

Colin Vaughan
Flat 120 Brenchley Gardens

triage.action: Two actions: (1) Repairs Planning Manager (Kwame Asante) to raise or escalate the heating repair as Urgent today, supply temporary heaters and confirm the parts date - there is no open heating job for Flat 120 in FieldLoop; (2) add this contact to existing complaint CMP-24162 for the Complaints Officer (Mark Pennington). Do not open a new complaint.
triage.notes: Repeat complaint already open in the complaints table (CMP-24162, stage 1, received 2 Nov, response due 18 Nov). Planted data gap: the operative said parts were ordered but FieldLoop has no open heating job for this address - the job was probably closed in error. No heating + mobility + children in November = Urgent.

subject: Re: water through ceiling Flat 76
summary: Older tenant at Brenchley Gardens says water from the flat above is now dripping round the bedroom ceiling light and the plaster is bulging.

messages.body:
Hello

I rang yesterday about water coming through from upstairs. It's worse today, its dripping round the light fitting in the bedroom now and the ceiling has gone saggy. The lady on the phone said it would be 4 weeks. I'm not using the light. My eyesight isnt good and I'm worried about going in there in the dark.

Leigh Curtis
Flat 76

triage.action: Upgrade job RJ402896 from Routine to Emergency today: electrician to isolate the circuit and make safe within 24 hours, plumber to trace and stop the leak from the flat above. Tell the Damp & Mould Surveyor - the tenant has open case DM1020 - and call Leigh back now with safety advice.
triage.notes: Planted error: RJ402896 ('water coming through ceiling from flat above') was logged on 3 Nov as Routine with a 1 Dec target. Water near a light fitting is an emergency under the repairs priorities. Leigh (71) has a sight impairment flag and an open Awaab's Law case DM1020.

subject: Brightline Electrical - completed jobs & invoice BL-26-1187
summary: Brightline Electrical sends October completions and an invoice; several lines have addresses but no Silvering job numbers.

messages.body:
Morning,

Please find attached our invoice BL-26-1187 for October works and the completion sheets.

A few of the jobs were passed to us by your planners over the phone so I don't have job numbers for those - I've put the addresses instead (Rosemount Tower x3, Brenchley Gdns x4, Orchard Fields x2). Can you let me have the numbers and I'll reissue if needed.

Payment terms 30 days as usual.

Thanks
Kayleigh
Accounts, Brightline Electrical Ltd

triage.action: Contract manager (Rob Quinlan) and the Repairs Planning Manager to match each line to a FieldLoop job number before the invoice goes to Finance for payment; ask Brightline to reissue with job numbers. Invoices must not be approved without a job number.

subject: Unable to attend - RJ401304 Flat 17 Rosemount Tower
summary: Brightline can't attend tomorrow's urgent electrical job at Rosemount Tower and asks for a new slot next week.

messages.body:
Hi team

Sorry, we've had two lads off sick and can't make RJ401304 (Flat 17 Rosemount Tower, hall light) tomorrow. Earliest we can do is Weds 11th AM. Can you let the resident know? We don't have a number for her.

Dean
Scheduling, Brightline Electrical

triage.action: Repairs Planning Manager to rebook - ideally with an in-house electrician before the 6 November target - or accept 11 November and record the reason. Contact Alexandra Turner (70, no email on file) by phone or letter.

subject: Quotation Q-4471 - 44 Brenchley Gardens fascia
summary: Weald Roofing sends a quotation for fascia replacement at 44 Brenchley Gardens and says scaffolding is needed.

messages.body:
Good morning,

Further to our visit on RJ401320, the fascia at 44 Brenchley Gardens is rotten along the full front elevation and the gutter is coming away with it. We recommend replacing the fascia and soffit in uPVC and renewing the gutter.

Quotation Q-4471 attached. This will need a scaffold (front only) - we can arrange through Hartwell as usual.

Regards

Contracts Manager
Weald Roofing & Guttering Ltd
01622 900 455

triage.action: Head of Repairs (Daniel Kerr, contract manager for Weald) to approve or query the quotation and raise a PO; consider whether the Planned Works Surveyor should add the block to the roofline programme instead.

subject: Change of bank details - Weald Roofing & Guttering Ltd - URGENT
summary: Email purporting to be from Weald Roofing asks Silvering to update its bank details before Friday's payment run, from a lookalike domain.

messages.body:
Dear Accounts Payable,

Please be advised that Weald Roofing & Guttering Ltd has changed banks following a review of our business accounts. With immediate effect please make all payments to:

Account name: Weald Roofing & Guttering Ltd
Sort code: 60-83-71
Account number: 41927736

Weald Roofing & Guttering Ltd

triage.action: Do not reply, update details or forward to the supplier. Forward as an attachment to the Financial Controller (Ian Mackie) and IT (Craig Whitmore) today. triage.sla: Same working day (before Friday's payment run)
triage.notes: Lookalike domain: weald-roofing-guttering.co.uk vs the genuine wealdroofing.co.uk in inb-rep-07. No named sender, urgency, sent to the repairs mailbox rather than accounts, and asks for confirmation by email. Weald's contract ends 31 Dec 2026, which makes a 'bank change' story plausible.

subject: Orchard Fields Ph1 - weekly defects update wk 45
summary: Castlemere Construction's weekly defects update for Orchard Fields phase 1, listing closed and outstanding defects and asking for access to occupied homes.

subject: no hot water or heating 39 orchard fields
summary: New-build tenant at Orchard Fields says the heat pump has shown an error since the weekend and there is no heating or hot water.

messages.body:
Morning. Our heat pump has had a red light and error E-14 on the screen since Saturday and we have no heating or hot water. We've tried turning it off and on. We only moved in 3 weeks ago!! Who do I call, you or the builders?

Lynda
39 Orchard Fields

triage.action: New home within the defects period: Development Manager (Paul Whitaker) to report to Castlemere as an emergency defect today (no heating or hot water) and confirm the attendance time. Repairs to provide temporary heaters if Castlemere can't attend within 24 hours. Reply to Lynda with who will come and when.
triage.notes: Not an in-house repair - it's Castlemere's defect, but Silvering is still the landlord and must make sure it gets fixed. The heat pump commissioning issues in Castlemere's weekly update (inb-rep-09) are the likely cause.

subject: MySilvering: New repair request #MS-88214
summary: Portal notification of a new repair request: dripping kitchen tap at 55 Heron Way.

messages.body:
A new repair request has been submitted through MySilvering.

Reference: MS-88214
Resident: Josephine Thomas
Address: 55 Heron Way
Category: Plumbing - taps
Description: Kitchen cold tap dripping constantly, getting worse
Photos: 1
Preferred appointment: Any weekday morning

This request has NOT yet been converted into a FieldLoop job. Please review and approve in the MySilvering admin console.

triage.action: Repairs planner to approve and convert to a FieldLoop job (Routine plumbing) and book a morning appointment.
triage.notes: Routine. Note the portal does not create jobs automatically - unreviewed notifications are how repairs get lost.

subject: Can't do Tuesday - RJ405857
summary: Tenant at 75 Brenchley Gardens asks to move her bath leak appointment.

messages.body:

Thanks Sally
75 Brenchley Gdns

subject: CCTV survey result - 154 Brenchley Gardens (RJ402705)
summary: ClearFlow Drainage reports that a CCTV survey of a blocked shared drain found a collapsed pipe needing excavation, and asks for approval.

messages.body:
Hi Daniel / Repairs

We attended RJ402705 yesterday. Jetted the shared run at 152-156 Brenchley Gardens but it re-blocked within the hour. CCTV shows a collapsed section of clay pipe approx 3m from the rear inspection chamber, with root ingress.

We need to excavate and replace c. 2m of pipe. Estimate £2,350 + VAT, 1 day, plus reinstatement of the path. Residents at 152, 154 and 156 will have limited use of toilets and sinks until it's done.

Can you approve so we can book in for Monday?

CCTV report attached.

Paul
ClearFlow Drainage Ltd

triage.action: Head of Repairs (Daniel Kerr) to approve the works and raise the variation today so ClearFlow can attend Monday; ask the planner to warn the three households and consider re-prioritising as Urgent, since a blocked shared drain affects toilets.
triage.notes: The FieldLoop job is still Routine (target 30 Nov) although three homes have limited use of toilets - an under-prioritised job.

subject: Condensation on windows
summary: Vinters Rise tenant reports heavy condensation on windows each morning and some black spots on the bedroom window frame.

messages.body:
Hi,

Every morning there's water running down the inside of the windows in both bedrooms and some black spots are starting on the bedroom window frame and the silicone. I wipe it every day. Is there anything you can do, maybe a fan? Not urgent.

Kathryn Anderson
Flat 80 Vinters Rise

triage.action: Log a damp and mould report and pass to the Damp & Mould Surveyor for triage: a call within 2 working days, then an Awaab's Law hazard assessment. If significant, investigate within 10 working days (by 17 November 2026). Do not reply with 'open your windows' advice alone.
triage.sla: Triage call 2 working days; investigate within 10 working days if significant
triage.notes: Resident says 'not urgent', but every damp and mould report must be assessed - the triage key tests whether learners skip it.

subject: FW: Mr Murray Flat 157 - mould behind wardrobe
summary: In-house plumber forwards a note from a job: heavy mould found behind a wardrobe at an older resident's flat while fixing a radiator valve.

messages.body:
Hi all

Was at Flat 157 Brenchley Gardens today for the rad valve (done). Mr Murray asked me to look behind the wardrobe in the back bedroom - whole wall is black, floor to about 4 foot, and the carpet's damp. Smells bad. He's 76 and says he's been sleeping in the front room because of it.

Can someone get the damp team out. I've told him someone will ring.

Thanks
Lee

-----Original Message-----
From: Lee Barton (mobile)
Sent: 03 November 2026 15:31
Subject: Mr Murray

photos attached x4

triage.action: Log an operative-raised damp and mould case today. Damp & Mould Surveyor to assess the hazard - extensive mould affecting an older resident's sleeping space may be significant or an emergency - and investigate within 10 working days at the latest (by 17 November 2026). Call Mr Murray today as Lee promised.
triage.sla: Contact same day; investigate within 10 working days
triage.notes: Internal email in a shared mailbox - easy to dismiss as 'FYI'. Operatives should raise damp cases directly in FieldLoop rather than by email.

subject: Fire door - flat front door won't shut - Rosemount Tower
summary: Leaseholder at Rosemount Tower reports his flat front door closer is broken so the fire door doesn't self-close.

messages.body:
Evening,

The closer on my front door (Flat 23 Rosemount Tower) has snapped and the door doesn't shut by itself any more. I know these are meant to be fire doors. I'm a leaseholder so not sure if it's mine or yours to fix but thought I should tell you. I'm hard of hearing so email is best.

Chris Cooper

triage.action: Building Safety Manager (Fatima Begum) to arrange a door closer repair within 24 hours - flat entrance doors in a higher-risk building are a fire safety matter whatever the tenure - and record it against the Rosemount Tower fire door actions. Reply by email (hearing impairment) with the date.
triage.notes: Rosemount Tower is the only HRB and has overdue fire door actions. Leaseholder tenure isn't a reason to deprioritise; who pays can be settled later.

subject: rent payment
summary: Parkwood Court tenant on Universal Credit asks to pay arrears in small amounts and, in the middle of the email, says her ex-partner took her UC money, has been coming round and she is scared.

messages.body:
Hi

I got your letter about the rent arrears. I know I'm behind, I can pay £10 a week extra from my UC from the 15th if that's ok.

The reason I'm behind is my ex was taking the UC money when it went into the joint account. I've got my own account now. He's been coming round again the last couple of weeks and banging on the door at night and I'm scared to open it. Please don't send letters to the flat because he takes the post sometimes. Text is better.

Can you tell me if the £10 is ok

Chelsea
Flat 37 Parkwood Court

triage.action: Domestic abuse disclosure: pass today to the ASB & Tenancy Enforcement Officer (Gary Doyle, domestic abuse lead) and the Head of Neighbourhoods as safeguarding lead. Contact Chelsea by text to arrange a safe time to call, complete a DASH risk assessment, offer refuge/IDVA and police referral, and mark her contact preference as text only - no letters. Ask the Income Officer (Ryan Tait) to pause arrears escalation and agree the £10 arrangement, and consider asking DWP for an APA.
triage.notes: Subject 'rent payment' and a payment offer in the first paragraph - the disclosure is buried in the middle. Rent account is at Stage 2 (call and visit); a home visit or letter could put her at risk. The email must not be forwarded widely or pasted into other chats.

subject: Help - hardship fund? Flat 24 Shepway Green
summary: Shepway Green tenant who has received a Notice of Seeking Possession asks for help from the hardship fund after losing his job and having his UC sanctioned.

messages.body:
To the rent team

I got the notice saying you might take me to court for the rent. I owe {{sql:SELECT balance_gbp FROM rent_accounts WHERE tenancy_ref='TEN500528'|gbp2}}. I lost my job in the summer and then my UC got sanctioned for 6 weeks because I missed an appointment when my wife was in hospital. The sanction finishes this month.

I've heard you have a hardship fund. Can I apply? I don't want to lose the flat, we've been here since 2020.

Frank O'Neill
07700 900359

triage.action: Income Manager (Bev Saunders) to take this because a NOSP has been served: put any court referral on hold while a hardship fund application and income and expenditure assessment are completed, refer to money advice, and help Frank challenge or seek a hardship payment for the UC sanction. The Income Officer (Ryan Tait) to call him within 1 working day.
triage.notes: Rent account RA700528 is at 'NOSP served'. The pre-action protocol requires the landlord to consider support and affordable arrangements before issuing proceedings. Frank's APA is in place, so ongoing housing costs are paid direct; the arrears are historic.

subject: Universal Credit: Breathing Space moratorium notification - Ms J Wilson
summary: Debt Respite Scheme (Breathing Space) notification that a moratorium started on 2 November 2026 for Joanna Wilson's debts, including rent arrears.

messages.body:
DEBT RESPITE SCHEME (BREATHING SPACE)
NOTIFICATION TO CREDITOR

Debtor: Joanna Wilson
Address: Flat 108, Shepway Green, Maidstone
Type of moratorium: Standard breathing space
Start date: 02/11/2026
Debt adviser: Medway Money Advice (ref MMA-55120)

You are named as a creditor. During the moratorium you must not take any enforcement action, add interest or charges, or contact the debtor to request payment of the qualifying debt. Ongoing liabilities (such as current rent) must continue to be paid.

You may request a review of the moratorium within 20 days of the start date.

This is an automated notification. Do not reply to this email.

triage.action: Income Manager (Bev Saunders) to record the moratorium on rent account RA700612 today and stop all enforcement and arrears contact for the arrears debt (the account is at NOSP served - no court application may be made). Ongoing rent is still due. Tell the Income Officer (Sam Odukoya) and diary the end date.
triage.notes: A legal requirement, not just information - breaching a moratorium makes enforcement action void. Joanna also has a mobility vulnerability flag. Easy to file as an automated 'do not reply' notice.

subject: Paid twice?
summary: Lenham Meadows tenant thinks her rent was taken twice this month and asks for a refund.

messages.body:
Morning, I think you've taken my rent twice. I paid by card on the app on the 31st and then the direct debit went out on the 2nd as well. Can I have one back please, I'm short this month.

Bethany Hunt, flat 57 Lenham Meadows

triage.action: Income Officer (Priya Chauhan) to check the payments on the rent account. Explain that the account is in arrears on a payment arrangement, so a second payment will usually reduce arrears rather than be refunded - but offer a refund if it causes hardship.
triage.notes: Her rent account has arrears on a payment arrangement, so the 'overpayment' is probably not an overpayment. Watch for Copilot promising a refund.

subject: Your Paylink daily collections file - delayed

subject: Dad - Flat 4 Bearsted Court
summary: Son of a 95-year-old SilverLiving resident tells the rents team his father died at the weekend and asks what happens to the flat and the rent.

messages.body:
Hello,

I'm writing to let you know that my father George Hamilton of Flat 4 Bearsted Court passed away on Saturday in hospital.

I'm not sure what I need to do about the flat or the rent. I live in Ashford and will need some time to clear his things. Can someone tell me what happens next and who I should speak to?

Thank you

Andrew Hamilton

triage.action: SilverLiving Coordinator (Margaret Ogunleye) to phone Andrew within 1 working day with condolences and explain the end-of-tenancy process (notice, clearance period, keys). Tell the Income team to suspend arrears action and the Voids Supervisor. Follow the bereavement name-change and contact process; no standard letters to 'the occupier'.
triage.notes: Bereavement process was reviewed after a previous complaint (complaints 'learning' column). Wrong mailbox - it should go to SilverLiving/tenancy, not rents.

subject: boiler
summary: Larkfield Close tenant writes to the rents mailbox to say his boiler has stopped and there's no hot water or heating.

messages.body:
My boiler stopped last night no heating or hot water. Pressure gauge is on 0. Sorry don't know the repairs email. 30 Larkfield Close. My daughter has asthma.

Rhys

triage.action: Wrong mailbox: forward to Repairs straight away and raise a heating job today - no heating or hot water with a child with asthma in November should be treated as Emergency/Urgent. Call Rhys back with the appointment.
triage.notes: Rhys is also in arrears at Stage 2. Don't let that colour the response - repairs and arrears are separate. The 'asthma' detail is the vulnerability signal.

subject: Rent increase letter?? Flat 21 Vinters Rise
summary: Leaseholder at Vinters Rise asks why he received an arrears notice when he only pays ground rent and service charges.

messages.body:
I own my flat (21 Vinters Rise - bought it under right to buy). I've had a letter about 'rent arrears' and something about a notice. I don't pay rent! I pay the service charge, which I dispute because the cleaning of the stairs never happens. Who do I speak to?

Scott Hart

triage.action: Income Manager (Bev Saunders) to review the account: a leaseholder's service charge arrears must be pursued under the lease, not by a rent-arrears NOSP. Check the wording of the letter sent, respond within 1 working day, and pass the cleaning dispute to the Complaints team as a possible stage 1 complaint.
triage.notes: Planted data issue: rent account RA700430 (leasehold) shows recovery stage 'NOSP served'. A NOSP under the Housing Act 1988 doesn't apply to a long leaseholder, so either the data or the process is wrong.

subject: Re: Statement request
summary: Housing support worker asks for a rent statement for a Linton Lodge resident to support a Pension Credit claim; consent is mentioned but not attached.

messages.body:
Hi,

I'm supporting Mrs Rosie Knowles (Flat 3, Linton Lodge) with a Pension Credit and Housing Benefit claim. Please could you send me a rent statement for the last 12 months and confirmation of the weekly rent and service charges?

Mrs Knowles has signed our consent form - I'll send it over.

Many thanks

Priya Nandra
Housing Support Worker, AgeWell Kent

triage.action: Do not send the statement until signed consent is received (or Mrs Knowles confirms by phone). Reply asking for the consent form, then the Income Officer sends the statement securely.
triage.notes: Third-party request - the consent form is promised but not attached. A good test of whether Copilot drafts a reply that includes personal data too early.
